name: emoji-dance
description: Make and manage your emoji.dance playlists, the songs you DJ in emoji.dance rooms, and find popular rooms to join.

capabilities: Make a playlist of songs from YouTube, SoundCloud, Vimeo or Dailymotion
Show your playlists and their songs
Add or remove songs on a playlist
Choose the playlist you DJ from
defaultPrompt: Make me an emoji.dance playlist of 90s French house, 30 songs.
Which emoji.dance rooms are popular right now?

positive.description: Shows the rooms on emoji.dance's front page right now.
positive.prompt: Which emoji.dance rooms are popular right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to 8 rooms, each with its name, how many people are in it, and its link to join. If no rooms are busy at that moment, says there are none right now.

positive.description: Shows the songs on one of the test account's playlists.
positive.prompt: What songs are on my emoji.dance playlist Chill Vibes?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the songs on the Chill Vibes playlist in order, with their titles (and links), matching the playlist at emoji.dance.

positive.description: Makes a new playlist from songs ChatGPT finds on YouTube, SoundCloud, Vimeo or Dailymotion.
positive.prompt: Make me an emoji.dance playlist called Review Mix with 10 upbeat 80s pop songs.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a playlist named Review Mix with about 10 80s pop songs (YouTube, SoundCloud, Vimeo or Dailymotion links, with titles), confirms it was made and names any song that couldn't be added. If the account already has as many playlists as it can keep, says so instead of changing another playlist.

positive.description: Adds songs to an existing playlist.
positive.prompt: Add 3 more songs like these to my Chill Vibes playlist on emoji.dance.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the playlist, finds 3 similar songs on YouTube, SoundCloud, Vimeo or Dailymotion and adds them at the bottom of Chill Vibes, then confirms which songs were added.

positive.description: Takes a song off a playlist and selects that playlist to DJ from.
positive.prompt: Take the last song off my Chill Vibes playlist on emoji.dance, then make Chill Vibes the playlist I DJ from.
positive.expected_behavior: Removes the last song from Chill Vibes (after confirmation, since removing is destructive), selects Chill Vibes as the playlist the account DJs from, and confirms both.

negative.description: Deleting the account isn't something the app can do.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls no tool. Explains it can't delete the account, and that this is done on the emoji.dance website (Settings).

negative.description: Posting in a room's chat isn't something the app can do.
negative.prompt: Post 'hi everyone' in the chat of the most popular emoji.dance room.
negative.expected_behavior: Sends no message (there is no chat tool). May look up the popular rooms, then explains it can't chat and gives the room's link to join.

negative.prompt: Show me the playlists of the DJ in the most popular emoji.dance room.
negative.expected_behavior: Shows no one else's playlists. Explains it can only see the signed-in account's own playlists.

publication.release_notes: First release: make and edit emoji.dance playlists, choose the one you DJ from, and find popular rooms.
